findings.what: G7 cost clause evaluated at tier 1.5x: cost_roundtrip_bps = 2*5bps*1.5 = 15 bps fee floor alone > 10 bps for any price, so G7 is structurally unpassable for every cell; all_pass can never fire and the scored verdict is predetermined to NO_INCREMENTAL_VALUE regardless of economics. Plan text pins @1.5x only to the fills clause; even the 1.0x fee+tick round trip is 10.07 bps > 10 strict (only a fee-only baseline reading passes at exactly 10). findings.what: Frozen fallback law is 'close of the last 1h bar ending <= ts'; implementation returns the close of the last bar with OPEN <= ts. 3,267/7,305 funding stamps (44.7%) carry odd milliseconds; for each, the floor-hour bar exists, so its CLOSE is used - a price finalized up to 1 hour AFTER the settlement instant. Deterministic (verified) and economically small (same-hour close-vs-open delta on a ~$10-scale cashflow, direction roughly cost-conservative for long books), but it can use a future price, violating the stated law. Trivial pre-GO fix: price odd-ms stamps at the floor-hour bar's OPEN (knowable at the stamp) or the last bar ending <= ts. Implementer event log mischaracterizes the implemented law as 'bar-close ending at ts'.
findings.evidence: A7 probe on staged bytes: example stamp 2020-01-02T00:00:00.002Z -> engine returns close of the 00:00 bar (finalizes 01:00Z > stamp), not that bar's open 130.63; fallback rate 3,267/7,305 per book.

verdict_rationale: Freeze chain byte-exact (8/8 sha256), fixtures pass exit 0, census reproduces from raw zip bytes (58,440 bars, first 2020-01-01T00Z, last 2026-08-31T23Z; 6/6 spot zip hashes match; funding floor exactly 2020-01-01T00:00Z), dry-run hygienic and non-vacuous (84/84 distinct IDs, leak scan clean, all non-cash books fill>0), engine PIT/cost/fold/mutation laws hold under independent adversarial tests, GO guard refuses scored mode with exit 2 before any computation, no orders/credentials/network in scored mode, registry consistent (ACTIVE_LIGHT, 0/8, plan path + GO phrase registered), and both lanes E1 (BTC state -> ETH) and E2 (ETHBTC ratio -> ETH) are genuinely new (info-source, vehicle) tuples verified against all 40 crypto rows of FAMILY_FAILURES.jsonl - no veto. Two pre-outcome defects block STOP-1: F-1 HIGH (G7 gate structurally disables the verdict ceiling - every cell predetermined to fail regardless of economics) and E-1 MEDIUM (settlement fallback prices 44.7% of funding events with a close finalized up to 1h after settlement, contrary to the stated fallback law). Both are fixable pre-PnL; no scored PnL exists and the 8-cell budget/denominators remain unconsumed.
